'''Waglin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and friend of [[Cix Trouvee]]. He flew with Trouvee as the co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the years leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], flying with him during the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Imperial era)|battle of Yag'Dhul]] in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces targeted the [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] on one of [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul's]] outer [[Moon/Legends|moons]], believing them to be supplying information to the [[Yag'Dhul insurgents]].

By [[43 ABY]], Waglin lived on [[Oseon VII]]. He was still a close friend of the Trouvee family, even after Cix's death that year. Later that year, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and their adopted daughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], embarked on a quest to find out more about the ''Millennium Falcon''<nowiki></nowiki>'s past. They spoke with Waglin, discovering from him that the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] had been bought from the [[Molpol's Traveling Circus]].
